name: Glibness

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: For an hour you can treat any Charisma check roll as a 15, and truth-detecting magic reads you as honest.
text: Whenever you make a Charisma check you can replace the d20 roll with 15. Magic that would tell whether you're lying always says you're telling the truth.
